preconditions.description: The number of engineers N is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly N+1 lines: one for N and N lines for engineer preferences.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 * int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: All desk numbers in preferences are between 1 and 2*N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len({line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]}) == int(stdin.split()[0])
preconditions.description: No two engineers currently sit at the same desk (all current desks are unique).

postconditions.description: The output is the number of valid seating arrangements modulo 1000000007, where a valid arrangement is a bijection from current desks to new desks such that each engineer either stays at their current desk or moves to their desired desk, and no two engineers share a desk in the new arrangement.
